changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: Add system.users.credentials_version, a counter that every password change or administrator reset increments. A session records the value it was issued with and is rejected once the account's value has moved on, so changing or resetting a password ends the other open sessions.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE system.users ADD COLUMN credentials_version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE system.users DROP COLUMN credentials_version;
